info.title: stability/sdxl-1.0-masking
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "stability/sdxl-1.0-masking", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Comfy Router request for Stability SDXL 1.0 masking, in Stability's v1 JSON shape. Repaints the masked part of `init_image`. Any other field is refused with 400. Billed once per image returned.

text_prompts.text: a lighthouse on a cliff at sunset, oil painting

cfg_scale.description: How strictly the image follows the prompt. Default 7.

clip_guidance_preset.description: Stability's CLIP guidance preset, for example `NONE`.

init_image.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of the source image.

mask_image.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of the mask. Required with MASK_IMAGE_WHITE and MASK_IMAGE_BLACK, refused with INIT_IMAGE_ALPHA.

mask_source.description: Where the mask comes from. MASK_IMAGE_WHITE and MASK_IMAGE_BLACK read `mask_image`, repainting its white or black pixels; INIT_IMAGE_ALPHA reads the alpha channel of `init_image`.

samples.description: Number of images to generate. Default 1. Each image returned is billed.

seed.description: Seed for the whole batch. 0 or omitted picks a random seed.

text_prompts.description: Prompts, each with an optional weight. A negative weight makes it a negative prompt.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for the Stability image models. The image is generated on Comfy-hosted infrastructure and stored on Comfy storage: `image` is a Comfy-signed URL valid for up to 24 hours, not a Stability URL, so download it before then. If the image cannot be stored, the call answers 502 and is not billed; no other URL is returned.

image.description: Comfy-signed URL of the (first) PNG image, valid for up to 24 hours.

images.description: SDXL only, when more than one image was returned. Every Comfy-signed image URL, in output order, each valid for up to 24 hours.

seed.description: The seed the image was generated with.
